Wu Xuan and Peng Cheng are both landscape photography enthusiasts, preparing to go on a road trip together, but they have a dispute over the choice of travel destination. Yanan is their friend and also a travel agency staff. When the argument starts to heat up, Wu Xuan glances at Yanan, she is reading a travel guide about snow mountains. After a little consideration, Wu Xuan shifts the topic to the photography equipment needed for the trip, involving professional skills of snow mountain environment photography.

[Question]
What does Wu Xuan want to do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Wu Xuan invites Yanan to join their trip.
B. Wu Xuan shows his photography knowledge.
C. Wu Xuan lets Yanan participate in deciding their travel destination.
D. Wu Xuan proposes the snow mountain as their travel destination.
